Subject: DataLoom onboarding: COI, subprocessors, and PO timing

Hi Sam —

Congrats on the green light from the product team. To finish procurement and get a PO issued we need the following items from DataLoom:

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) that includes Cyber/Professional Liability and General Liability (limits listed below)
- Endorsement naming Redwood Inference as Additional Insured (or confirmation your insurer will add our standard endorsement)
- List of subprocessors and whether any subprocessors store customer data (we only need an inventory, not access credentials)
- W9 or tax documentation for vendor setup

Minimum insurance expectations: GL $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate; Cyber/PL $1M. If you have higher limits, please include them.

Also please confirm whether DataLoom requires Redwood to sign any of your standard vendor terms before PO issuance (we prefer to issue PO + Master Services Agreement signature after insurance is validated).

If you can upload the COI and the subprocessors spreadsheet to the DocuSign packet linked below or reply with attachments, I’ll route to finance for a PO. Target timeline: PO within 3 business days of acceptance of COI/endorsement.

Thanks —
Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference

Thanks — attaching the COI and the current subprocessors inventory. Quick notes: 

- COI attached (DataLoom_COI_2025-03-23.pdf). Our carrier included GL and Cyber limits at $2M/$2M and $2M respectively.
- Subprocessors list attached (DataLoom_Subprocessors_2025-03-23.xlsx). Two subprocessors handle parts of telemetry ingestion; they do not persist customer-identifiable data.

Also, we have a standard Master Services Agreement (MSA) we prefer to execute; however, we can accept a PO on our then-current terms and follow up on MSA execution. Will a conditional PO work here?

Aisha —

This looks fine from procurement and finance perspective. Carrier limits exceed our minimums. Marcus, do you need to see the endorsement language for accounting/contract tagging? My recommendation: issue a conditional PO (DL-2025-88-PO1) with the following conditions:

1) Redwood will issue PO now to avoid delaying onboarding; payment will be held until endorsement is uploaded or insurer confirmation is provided (7 calendar days).
2) PO will reference deal id DL-2025-88 and include the clause: "Issuance conditional upon receipt of Additional Insured endorsement as specified by Redwood."
3) If endorsement is not received within 7 days, PO is suspended and services are paused until cleared.

If Marcus signs off, I’ll route the PO for creation.
